group by pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID, T1.FINPROD_ID, PP.INVEST_YESORNO, T1.INV_AIM, T1.CDATE, T1.AMOUNT, T1.HODING_TYPE, T4.PAY_CYCLE ) group by cash_id, CASH_TYPE, PORTFOLIO_ID, PORTFOLIO_NAME, INVEST_YESORNO, FINPROD_ID, INV_AIM, CDATE, vDate, mDate, yield, CALC_RULE having SUM(AMOUNT) > 0
